validation.notes: Repaired two independent regressions across the real producer/consumer flow. In packages/coding-agent/src/migrations.ts, migrateSessionsFromAgentRoot() now uses continue instead of return when a destination file already exists, so a leading collision no longer aborts the batch and leaves the later valid session unmigrated; colliding source and destination bytes remain unchanged. In packages/coding-agent/src/core/session-manager.ts, loadEntriesFromFile() now pushes the parsed unterminated final JSONL record before appending the newline repair, so the tail is retained exactly once and remains recoverable. The regression loads the submitted modules through the read-only .prale-eval/subject.mjs createSessionPipeline VM helper (real migrations, session manager, and path/text helpers; only the agent-dir boundary and deterministic readdir ordering are harness-provided). It builds a legacy agent-root batch with a first-file collision and a last-file valid session whose final record has no newline, then asserts collision byte preservation, continued migration, ordered Unicode payloads, malformed-line skipping, exactly-once tail retention, a single newline repair, idempotent re-read, SessionManager leaf discovery, and safe append after repair. Baseline mutation checks were run individually: restoring only migrations.ts failed with 'valid session after the collision must be migrated' and restoring only session-manager.ts failed with 'reader must retain every valid record in order, including the unterminated final record', both as uncaught node:assert/strict AssertionErrors rather than crashes or import errors. Temporary fixtures under .prale-eval/tmp are cleaned up. No optional dependencies were unavailable and no network, credentials, or deployment were used.
